title: knowgov trace report
description: What `python harness/trace.py register|check -f json` prints (task-0051): the registered outputs (register: those just recorded; check: those in scope, with their state against the files and the statements they used now invalidated), the task's gate on the store as it is (check only), the findings on the contract's severity ladder (kind suspect, unmapped, missing, drift, or gate:<the gate report's kind>), the threshold and the exit code. A registered row's as_of is the date its registration read (task-0093, additive); its keys, the keys a hand-written file was registered on with --keys or --cited (task-0124, additive), with the finding kinds unknown_key, malformed_citation, uncited and uncitable. A finding that rests on keys names their owner and route, and the gate block what the gate decided on (task_profile, register, knowgov), as the gate report does (task-0304, decision-0035 B2, additive), and corpus, attestations, captures and configuration, the gate report's, from the store the check reads (task-0335, decision-0039 §3.2, additive), and code and preload (task-0341, decision-0040 (a), additive). Version 1; a change is additive or a new version. Exit 2 prints no report.

task_profile.description: task-0304 (decision-0035 B2): as the gate report's (version 3, decision-0029): the sha256, hex, of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8) of the subject's [tasks.<class>] table the gate read, as its manifest gives it, with the keys asked for in place of its own when a key set was asked for (task keys); null when no table was read

register.description: task-0304 (decision-0035 B2): as the gate report's (version 3, decision-0029): the register the gate read, KG_REGISTER: a vendored copy's SOURCE.md, else an instance checkout's git HEAD and the tag exactly on it, read without the network

tag.description: null when no tag names the commit, or the register is unknown

commit.description: 40 hex; null when unknown, with why

why.description: why the commit is unknown; null when it is known

files.description: task-0320 (decision-0038 N2), optional and additive: as the gate report's register.files, the digest of the register's files a load reads (harness/register_impact.py loaded_files, files_digest)

knowgov.description: task-0304 (decision-0035 B2): as the gate report's (version 3, decision-0029): the knowgov build that judged, task-0227's identity (harness/build_identity.py), as store_status reports it; each null when it cannot be known

corpus.description: task-0335 (decision-0039 §3.2), optional and additive: as the gate report's, read from the store the check reads: task-0307 (decision-0037), added since without a version change: the corpus the gate decided on, the sha256, hex, of one line per document Version the store holds, the canonical JSON array [artefact, version, sha256] (no whitespace, UTF-8, a null kept null) and a newline, the lines sorted (harness/store.py corpus_digest; canonical lines, task-0320, decision-0038 N4: a tab or newline in a value, or null against "", never collides), every Version counted, a stage-2 change's earlier one included; equal on both stores and through export and import; null when no Version is loaded. With --baseline, a corpus that differs from the baseline's is named in baseline.differs and on stderr, never in the exit

attestations.description: task-0335 (decision-0039 §3.2), optional and additive: as the gate report's, read from the store the check reads: task-0320 (decision-0038 N2), optional and additive: the subject manifest's [verification], [provenance] and [capture] as the load read them, the sha256, hex, of the canonical JSON {"verification": .., "provenance": .., "capture": ..} (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8, a TOML date as its ISO text, a table the manifest lacks null; harness/load.py attestations_digest), recorded in the store at the load (Store.record_inputs) and read back, so a --no-load or MCP read names the load's; equal on both stores and through export and import; null on a store loaded before it

captures.description: task-0335 (decision-0039 §3.2), optional and additive: as the gate report's, read from the store the check reads: task-0320 (decision-0038 N2), optional and additive: the answers and reviews the load applied, the sha256, hex, of the canonical JSON {"captures": c, "reviews": r}, c and r each the digest of the sorted [file name, digest of its content as read] of the capture files the load ingested and of the review files it applied (another scenario's review and a refused one left out; harness/load.py applied_digest), recorded at the load and read back (Store.inputs); null on a store loaded before it

configuration.description: task-0335 (decision-0039 §3.2), optional and additive: as the gate report's, read from the store the check reads: task-0335 (decision-0039 §3.2), optional and additive: the subject's configuration files the load read, each by its path under the subject root as the manifest names it, to the sha256, hex, of its raw bytes as read: subject.toml whole, scenarios.toml, the register map ([register] map), and plants.toml, queries.toml and the verification map ([verification] map) where read, a file that is not there left out (harness/subject.py Subject.configuration); recorded at the load (Store.record_inputs) and read back (Store.inputs), so a --no-load or MCP read names the load's; equal on both stores and through export and import; with --baseline compared whole, a file read on one side only a difference; null on a store loaded before it

code.description: task-0341 (decision-0040 (a)), optional and additive: as the gate report's, read from the store the check reads: task-0341 (decision-0040 (a)), optional and additive: the code and suite an execution verification is compared against, each file the load's part selection reads for [reference] code (a file, or a directory's *.py files) and for [oracle] script with each path [oracle] suite lists (harness/subject.py code_files), by its path under the subject root as the manifest names it (a directory's file as <it>/<relative>), to the sha256, hex, of its raw bytes, a file that is not there left out, {} when the manifest declares neither (Subject.code); recorded at the load (Store.record_inputs) and read back (Store.inputs), so a --no-load or MCP read names the load's; equal on both stores and through export and import; with --baseline compared whole, a file on one side only a difference; null on a store loaded before it, or when a path lies outside the instance

path.description: the report's path as KG_PRELOAD_REPORT names it, else preload-report.json, the instance's own; null when none was applied

sha256.description: the sha256, hex, of the report's raw bytes; null when none was applied

why.description: why no report was applied (KG_PRELOAD_REPORT unset and the instance holds none, or the subject is in no instance); null when one was

preload.description: task-0341 (decision-0040 (a)), optional and additive: as the gate report's, read from the store the check reads: task-0341 (decision-0040 (a)), optional and additive: the pre-load report the load applied (harness/preload.py identity: KG_PRELOAD_REPORT, else <instance>/preload-report.json), its path and the digest of its raw bytes, or both null with why when none was applied; recorded at the load (Store.record_inputs) and read back (Store.inputs); equal on both stores and through export and import; with --baseline compared whole, so a report applied on one side only is a difference; null on a store loaded before it

owner.description: task-0304 (decision-0035 B2): on a finding that rests on keys (suspect, drift, missing, unbound, and a gate finding the gate gives one), the unit that answers for every one of them, from the subject's register_map.toml, as the gate report's key findings name it (task-0102); null when no unit or several answer; absent on a finding that rests on no key

route.description: task-0304: with owner, the route to an answer: the owner's questionnaire for the scenario the store holds and the task (task-0009), or each owning unit's when several own the keys; null when there is none

used_changed.description: task-0199: the statements the ledger recorded whose value or digest changed under their id since, or that are gone; absent when none

as_of.description: the date the registration read the task's gate on (task-0093); absent from a ledger entry written before it

keys.description: the keys a hand-written file rests on, from --keys or its header citation (task-0124); absent from an output registered on statements
